commandBrief.label: UPCOMING RACE
commandBrief.title: Austin Grand Prix · October 23–25
commandBrief.text: Round 18 at Circuit of the Americas; standard weekend. FP1 Friday at 12:30 local; race Sunday at 15:00 local.

commandBrief.label: CHAMPIONSHIP
commandBrief.title: Antonelli leads Russell by 102
commandBrief.text: Antonelli 340 points, Russell 238. One title-clinching combination requires Antonelli to win, Russell P9 or lower and Hamilton P5 or lower.

commandBrief.label: DRIVER FORM
commandBrief.title: Verstappen chasing a third straight Grand Prix win
commandBrief.text: Verstappen won the last two Grands Prix at Sepang and Singapore; Red Bull is seven points behind McLaren in the constructors’ battle.

commandBrief.label: FRIDAY FP1 DRIVER WATCH
commandBrief.title: Herta in Cadillac for Austin FP1
commandBrief.text: Cadillac has assigned American test driver Colton Herta to Sergio Pérez’s car for Friday FP1 at 12:30 CDT. Pérez is scheduled to return for FP2 at 16:00 CDT. Herta took his first IndyCar win at COTA in 2019.
